newsitem.title: GERMANY: First German July state CPI data due on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: First German July state CPI data due on Wednesday.

text.p: The statistics offices of the German states of Bavaria and Hesse said on Tuesday that they plan to release provisional consumer price data for July early on Wednesday.

The state of North Rhine-Westphalia said it would release its report either late on Wednesday or on Thursday, while the state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said it has provisionally planned to release its report on Friday, July 25.
Data from the four states is used to compute provisional west German consumer price data.
